description: Defines initialization functions and types for neural network tensors in the torch::nn::init namespace, including functions for setting tensor values and calculating gain based on nonlinearity types.

methods.name: calculate_gain
methods.description: Returns the recommended gain value for a specified nonlinearity function.

methods.name: constant_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a specified scalar value in-place.

methods.name: dirac_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with the Dirac delta function in-place.

methods.name: eye_
methods.description: Fills a 2D tensor with an identity matrix.

methods.name: normal_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with values drawn from a normal distribution.

methods.name: orthogonal_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a (semi) orthogonal matrix.

methods.name: sparse_
methods.description: Fills a tensor as a sparse matrix with specified sparsity.

methods.name: uniform_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with values from a uniform distribution.

methods.name: kaiming_normal_
methods.description: Initializes a tensor with Kaiming normal distribution.

methods.name: kaiming_uniform_
methods.description: Initializes a tensor with Kaiming uniform distribution.

methods.name: xavier_normal_
methods.description: Initializes a tensor with Xavier normal distribution.

methods.name: xavier_uniform_
methods.description: Initializes a tensor with Xavier uniform distribution.

methods.name: _calculate_fan_in_and_fan_out
methods.description: Calculates fan-in and fan-out for a tensor.
